notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts gives name, county and an agency pairing (Ouachita National Forest). Mapcarta used only for the position relative to Haworth. The Jadie Tower NHLR page names a Tiak Ranger District; that is about Jadie, and no source ties this tower to the district, so the story only notes the shared name. The Oklahoman 2025 fire-tower article (Johnnie Breece) returned HTTP 403 to fetch_text and to WebFetch and was not read; it may mention towers in this county. The Forest Heritage Center Facebook post was unreadable. The asterisk beside TIAK in the Oklahoma index is unexplained. Used 2 WebSearch calls and about 5 page reads. Story is 113 words, below the 120 minimum, because no further evidence was found.
